overview_description.description: Akon Labs develops GitNexus, a code intelligence engine that indexes repositories into a queryable knowledge graph. The product maps dependencies, call chains, execution flows, and cross-repository relationships to support code analysis and software engineering agents. GitNexus is available as open-source software and through enterprise deployments that include managed SaaS, self-hosted, and air-gapped options, along with pull-request analysis, repository indexing, and access controls.
